theater: 西西里東岸與北非迦太基沿岸

battle.name: 第三次西西里戰爭
battle.theater: 西西里東岸與北非迦太基沿岸
battle.brief: 公元前315年至前307年，迦太基與敘拉古為爭奪西西里島在島上與北非沿岸開戰。僭主阿加索克利斯先奪墨西拿，311年兵敗希梅拉河，圍城的迦太基軍又被他前310年的北非登陸牽制。卡面的希臘重步兵是雙方步兵的骨架，卻非前310年白突尼斯之戰的真實陣列。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 公元前315年至前307年的第三次西西里戰爭，交戰的兩端是迦太基與敘拉古。敘拉古這邊由僭主阿加索克利斯執政，他於前317年以政變推翻「五百人」寡頭，前315年又以武力奪下墨西拿，把海峽東岸收入版圖，島上的希臘城邦多被置於他的霸權之下；他個人的宮廷同時就是最高指揮部，前311年進攻阿克拉加斯、前310年偷渡北非都由他一人決定。敘拉古的軍隊以公民重步兵方陣為骨幹，輔以克里特與羅德的弓手以及各色雇傭兵，攻城時靠工兵帶來的攻城塔與填壕器械。迦太基這邊由元老院與「和平與救國委員會」共同決策，在島上的統帥是基斯科之子哈米卡爾，他麾下是迦太基公民步兵為骨幹、加上伊比利亞與努米底亞雇傭兵，並有腓尼基式海軍掌握西西里海峽的航運。島內城市如阿克拉加斯、卡米拉、塞利努斯與希梅拉一度倒向迦太基或保持中立，把雙方拖進內戰式的消耗。戰場在前310年之後延伸到北非突尼斯海岸：敘拉古軍圍困迦太基城，迦太基則一面在非洲集結援軍，一面仍由哈米卡爾在島上施壓，形成兩條戰線互相牽制的局面。
countriesEn: The Third Sicilian War of 315 to 307 BC was fought between Carthage and Syracuse. On the Syracusan side power was held by the tyrant Agathocles, who had overthrown the oligarchy of the Five Hundred in 317 BC and who seized Messana by force in 315 BC, bringing the eastern shore of the strait under his control and drawing most of the Greek cities of the island under his hegemony. His personal court was at the same time the highest command authority: the attack on Akragas in 311 BC and the secret crossing to Africa in 310 BC were both his own decisions. The Syracusan army rested on a phalanx of citizen heavy infantry, supplemented by Cretan and Rhodian archers and a mixture of mercenaries, while siege work was handled by engineers with towers and filling equipment. Carthage on the other hand decided through the senate and the council of Peace and Salvation; its commander in Sicily was Hamilcar son of Gisco, whose host combined Carthaginian citizen infantry with Iberian and Numidian mercenaries, while a Phoenician-style navy kept the shipping lanes of the Sicilian strait under Carthaginian control. Island cities such as Akragas, Camarina, Selinus and Himera at one point sided with Carthage or stayed neutral, dragging both parties into a civil-war-like wearing contest. After 310 BC the battlefield extended to the Tunisian coast of North Africa: the Syracusan army besieged Carthage itself, while Carthage massed relief forces in Africa and Hamilcar kept up the pressure in the island, so that the two fronts held each other in check.
people: 阿加索克利斯是這場戰爭的關鍵人物，公元前361年生於希梅拉，父親卡爾基諾斯原是累西昂的陶工，他憑軍功與財富在民主派與寡頭派的鬥爭中崛起，前317年清洗「五百人」議會奪權，前304年和約之後自稱西西里之王。他的父親狄俄尼索斯一世曾於前405年至前367年統治敘拉古，前367年被推翻流放，阿加索克利斯少年時便在這段動盪歲月裡長大。迦太基方面的核心是哈米卡爾，基斯科之子，他主持前314至前313年與敘拉古的調停，又在前311年以反擊奪回西西里西部大部分地區並包圍敘拉古；前310年他被迫抽回兵力對付阿加索克利斯的非洲登陸，前306年和約後在迦太基遭到追責。哈諾與哈米卡爾共同統率前310年白突尼斯之戰的迦太基軍，慘敗之後仍重整防禦。昔蘭尼的統治者奧斐拉斯於前309年率軍加入阿加索克利斯一方，約定瓜分非洲戰果，前307年卻倒戈夜襲希臘營地，成為敘拉古在非洲崩潰的直接原因。阿加索克利斯留在非洲接掌軍權的兒子阿爾卡加圖斯在前307年的兵變中被殺，父子先後退出非洲戰線。
peopleEn: Agathocles is the central figure of the war. Born at Himera in 361 BC, the son of Carcinus, a potter originally from Rhegium, he rose through military service and wealth in the struggle between the democratic and oligarchic factions, purged the council of the Five Hundred and seized power in 317 BC, and proclaimed himself king of Sicily after the peace of 304 BC. His father Dionysius I had ruled Syracuse from 405 to 367 BC and was overthrown and exiled in 367 BC, so Agathocles grew up in those turbulent years. On the Carthaginian side the key man was Hamilcar son of Gisco, who brokered the settlement with Syracuse in 314/313 BC, then in 311 BC struck back, recovered most of western Sicily and besieged Syracuse. In 310 BC he was forced to withdraw troops to meet Agathocles' landing in Africa, and after the peace of 306 BC he was held accountable at Carthage. Hanno and Hamilcar together commanded the Carthaginian army at the Battle of White Tunis in 310 BC and reorganized their defences even after the defeat. Ophellas, ruler of Cyrenaica, joined Agathocles with his troops in 309 BC on an agreement to share the African conquests, but in 307 BC he defected and attacked the Greek camp by night, which was the direct cause of the collapse of the Syracusan army in Africa. Archagathus, the son whom Agathocles left in command in Africa, was killed in a mutiny there in 307 BC, so father and son left the African front in turn.
kits: 卡面所畫的希臘重步兵是雙方步兵的骨架：直徑約一公尺的圓盾（aspis）、胸甲、脛甲、頭盔，加上一支約兩公尺半的長矛與短劍，靠著盾牌相接、矛尖越過前排盾頂的密集縱深作戰。公元前315至前307年時，實際裝備已與卡面這個公元前500年前後的祖型有出入：盾逐漸放大為可以遮住身體的塔盾（thureos），青銅胸甲多被皮甲與亞麻背心取代，頭盔多不再有科林斯式的鼻護；但「以盾為城」的核心仍然不變，前311年希梅拉河之戰與前310年白突尼斯之戰的方陣主力都是這類重步兵。迦太基的步兵以公民兵為骨幹，配伊比利亞與凱爾特伊比利亞雇傭兵，裝備以短劍、較小的圓盾與頭盔為主，並有努米底亞騎兵與象兵；前307年的北非戰線上雙方都用到象，狄奧多羅斯留下記載。海權方面，迦太基的單列槳船與五列槳船是主要工具，敘拉古在圍城期間靠船隊運糧，兩軍的兵員輸送同樣依賴海路。攻城與營地方面有撞槌、破城槌、雲梯與土壘，敘拉古圍困迦太基時築起環形圍牆與壘道，迦太基則以艦隊夜襲希臘船營並破壞攻城器械。
kitsEn: The Greek heavy infantry on the card is the backbone of the infantry on both sides: a round shield (aspis) about one metre across, a cuirass, greaves and a helmet, together with a spear roughly two and a half metres long and a short sword, fighting in a dense mass in which shields touch and spear points project past the shields of the front rank. Between 315 and 307 BC the actual equipment had already moved away from the archetype shown on the card, which belongs to around 500 BC: the shield grew into the taller thureos that could cover the body, bronze cuirasses were increasingly replaced by leather and linen, and helmets lost the Corinthian nose guard; yet the core idea of the shield wall remained, and the phalanx fought at the Battle of the Himera River in 311 BC and at the Battle of White Tunis in 310 BC was made up of such heavy infantry. Carthaginian infantry had citizen soldiers at its core, with Iberian and Celtiberian mercenaries, armed mainly with short swords, smaller round shields and helmets, and it included Numidian cavalry and elephants; elephants were used by both sides on the North African front in 307 BC, as Diodorus records. At sea, the single-decked and five-banked galleys of Carthage were the principal instruments, Syracusan siege operations were supplied by ship, and the movement of troops on both sides depended on sea routes. For siege work and camp works there were battering rams, siege hammers, scaling ladders and earthwork ramps: the Syracusans ringed Carthage with a circumvallation and a mound pushed up to the walls, while Carthage answered with night raids by the fleet against the Greek ship camp and with the destruction of siege machinery.
tactics: 敘拉古的方陣戰法是這場戰爭的主軸：重步兵列成數十排縱深，後排把盾壓在前排背上形成支撐，前排以矛尖齊平突出的方式推擠，側面靠盾緣互相扣住，任何一排被突破都會牽動全陣。前310年白突尼斯之戰中，阿加索克利斯以方陣正面迎擊迦太基及其盟軍的散兵線與騎兵，乘其隊形未整時壓上，奪下營地；前311年希梅拉河之戰則相反，敘拉古的方陣在野地正面對撞中吃虧，撤退時因陣形鬆散而損失擴大，顯示方陣面對主動選擇戰場的對手相對脆弱。迦太基的戰術重點是海陸兩線配合：前311至前309年以海軍封鎖敘拉古的港口、陸軍築圍城線逼城，圍城期間城內發生疫病流行，守軍依靠城牆、埃比尼亞港與島嶼地形逐段抵抗，而圍城軍同時被前310年敘拉古在北非的登陸牽制。前310至前307年，敘拉古在迦太基城外築環形圍牆、挖壕填溝、築壘道逼近城牆並企圖封鎖港口，迦太基則靠堅固城防與反覆出擊的援軍拖住對手。最後破局來自內部：前307年奧斐拉斯倒戈夜襲營地，希臘軍在缺乏統一指揮下迅速散潰，阿加索克利斯退回西西里。
tacticsEn: The Syracusan way of fighting, the phalanx, is the backbone of this war: heavy infantry were arrayed in tens of ranks of depth, the rear rank resting its shields on the backs of the rank in front, the front rank pressing forward with its spear points levelled and projecting beyond the shield line, and the flanks locked together by overlapping shield rims, so that a breach in any single rank pulls at the whole line. At the Battle of White Tunis in 310 BC Agathocles met the Carthaginians and their allies with the phalanx frontally, against a line of skirmishers and cavalry whose order had not yet been made, and pressed forward to take the enemy camp. The Battle of the Himera River in 311 BC went the other way: the Syracusan phalanx was worsted in a set-piece collision in open ground, and the losses grew as the formation loosened during the retreat, showing how brittle the phalanx could be against an opponent who chooses the ground. Carthaginian tactics stressed the combination of sea and land: from 311 to 309 BC the fleet blockaded the ports of Syracuse while the army built a circumvallation and pressed the city, plague broke out inside the besieged city, and the defenders held out in sections behind the walls, at the port of Euryalus and across the island terrain, while the besiegers were themselves pinned down by the Syracusan landing in Africa in 310 BC. From 310 to 307 BC the Syracusans built a ring wall around Carthage, dug trenches, filled them, pushed mounds up to the fortifications and tried to close the harbours, and Carthage simply relied on strong defences and repeated relief sorties to wear the attacker down. The final collapse came from within: in 307 BC Ophellas defected and attacked the camp by night, the Greek army dissolved for want of unified command, and Agathocles withdrew to Sicily.
data: 可以確定的數字不多，但仍有幾個骨架。前315年阿加索克利斯奪下墨西拿，扼住西西里海峽最窄處，寬度不足四公里；前311年希梅拉河之戰後，迦太基取得西西里島西部大部分地區，並自前311年至前309年包圍敘拉古；前310年阿加索克利斯率約一萬四千名作戰人員渡海北非，這個數字出自狄奧多羅斯的敘述；前310年白突尼斯之戰是這場戰爭中最接近決戰的一役；前307年希臘軍在北非崩潰，阿加索克利斯撤回西西里；前306年雙方議和，以哈利克斯河為界，前304年阿加索克利斯稱王。地理上，西西里島南北長約三百五十公里、面積約二萬五千平方公里，敘拉古到迦太基的海路繞過西西里海峽約四百公里上下；島上同一方向的主要城邦彼此相隔一日到數日行軍，島內城市指望海運得到糧秣與援兵。關於雙方的總兵力、戰損與圍城部隊的具體數字，現存希臘文記載沒有留下可靠數目，只有零散的劫掠、逃亡與疫病記載可用。
dataEn: The number of figures that can be fixed with confidence is small, but a few of them form a usable frame. In 315 BC Agathocles took Messana, closing the narrowest point of the Sicilian strait, which is less than four kilometres across. After the Battle of the Himera River in 311 BC Carthage held most of western Sicily, and from 311 to 309 BC it besieged Syracuse. In 310 BC Agathocles crossed to Africa with about fourteen thousand men fit for service, a figure that comes from the narrative of Diodorus. The Battle of White Tunis in 310 BC was the closest thing in this war to a decisive engagement. In 307 BC the Greek army collapsed in Africa and Agathocles withdrew to Sicily. In 306 BC the two sides made peace on the line of the Halycus river, and in 304 BC Agathocles took the title of king. Geographically, Sicily runs about three hundred and fifty kilometres north to south and covers roughly twenty-five thousand square kilometres; the sea route from Syracuse to Carthage, rounding the Sicilian strait, is on the order of four hundred kilometres. Within the island the chief cities in any one direction lie one to several days' march apart, and the island cities relied on the sea for grain and for reinforcements. As for the total strength of either side, the casualty figures and the exact size of the investing armies, the surviving Greek accounts leave no reliable numbers, and only scattered notices of plunder, flight and plague can be used.
cause: 第三次西西里戰爭的直接起點是前315年阿加索克利斯奪取墨西拿。墨西拿是海峽東岸的城市，迦太基與敘拉古都曾支持當地的馬默廷人首領互相攻殺，這座城市一旦落入敘拉古之手，迦太基在島西部的航運與此前維持的均勢便被打破，雙方不得不再次用兵。此前前410至前340年的第二次西西里戰爭已把島上分成迦太基管治的西部與希臘城邦的東部，前313至前312年哈米卡爾促成的和約只承認希臘城市的自治與敘拉古的霸權，並沒有解決西部歸屬與墨西拿的問題，於是前311年阿加索克利斯以進攻阿克拉加斯撕毀條約，開啟新一輪戰爭。個人層面上，阿加索克利斯需要一場勝仗來鞏固他靠政變建立的權位，迦太基則不能容忍一個把全島希臘城市收編於旗下的敘拉古。於是前310年他把戰場反過來推到迦太基的家門前，用一次冒險的渡海行動企圖以攻代守。
causeEn: The immediate spark of the Third Sicilian War was the seizure of Messana by Agathocles in 315 BC. Messana was the city on the eastern shore of the strait, whose local Mamertine leaders had been supported against one another by both Carthage and Syracuse; once the city fell to Syracuse, the Carthaginian shipping in the west of the island and the balance of power that had held before were broken, and both sides had to take up arms again. The Second Sicilian War of 410 to 340 BC had already divided the island into a Carthaginian-governed west and a Greek east, and the settlement brokered by Hamilcar in 313/312 BC recognised only the autonomy of the Greek cities and the hegemony of Syracuse without settling the ownership of the west or the question of Messana. In 311 BC Agathocles therefore tore up the treaty by attacking Akragas and opened a new round of war. On the level of individuals, Agathocles needed a victory to shore up the authority he had won by coup, and Carthage could not tolerate a Syracuse that folded every Greek city of the island into its own system. So in 310 BC he reversed the battlefield and carried it to the gates of Carthage, trying to convert attack into defence with one gamble across the sea.
impact: 前306年的和約畫出一條沿今日西西里北岸的地形界線：哈利克斯河（阿爾卡莫）以東歸敘拉古，以西歸迦太基。前304年阿加索克利斯稱西西里之王，島上大部分希臘城邦被納入他的王國體制，西西里由自治城邦聯盟變成以敘拉古為中心的王國，這個格局一直維持到羅馬在第一次布匿戰爭前介入為止。迦太基保住了西西里西部與北非基地，但元老院內的反對派以哈米卡爾的處置失當與和約條件追責，其政治地位受損；島上西部的商路與西側海域的控制權也從此被固定在兩家分割的格局裡。北非方面，敘拉古軍隊雖然深入到迦太基城牆之外，卻沒能攻陷這座有雙重城牆與港池的城，最後只能退回海島；敘拉古在西西里以外再無立足之地，海外擴張的方向被封死。對希臘世界而言，這場戰爭暴露了以方陣為核心的重步兵在面對象兵、騎兵與混合同盟軍時的極限，也顯示僭主軍隊依賴雇傭兵與個人決策的脆弱。阿加索克利斯前289年遇刺身亡，敘拉古隨即被捲入更廣的繼業者戰爭。
impactEn: The peace of 306 BC drew a line that follows the terrain of the modern northern coast of Sicily: east of the Halycus river, at Alcamo, went to Syracuse, west of it to Carthage. In 304 BC Agathocles styled himself king of Sicily, most of the Greek cities of the island were folded into his royal administration, and Sicily changed from a league of autonomous city states into a kingdom centred on Syracuse; that arrangement held until Rome intervened on the eve of the First Punic War. Carthage kept its base in western Sicily and in North Africa, but the opposition in its senate held Hamilcar accountable for his handling of affairs and for the terms of the settlement, and his political position was damaged. The trade routes of the western island and the control of the western sea were from then on fixed within a partition between two powers. In North Africa the Syracusan army pushed as far as the walls of Carthage without being able to take the city, which had a double circuit of walls and its harbours, and could only fall back to the island; Syracuse gained no foothold outside Sicily, and the direction of its overseas expansion was closed off. For the Greek world the war exposed the limits of the hoplite phalanx when faced with elephants, cavalry and mixed allied armies, and it also showed how fragile a tyrant's army is when it rests on mercenaries and on one man's decisions. Agathocles was assassinated in 289 BC, and Syracuse was immediately drawn into the wider wars of the Diadochi.
result: 雙方都沒有得到全勝。前307年阿加索克利斯在北非兵敗，軍隊潰散，他本人祕密撤回西西里，留在非洲的兒子阿爾卡加圖斯被自己人殺掉；迦太基收復北非失地，但島上的西線只推進到中部的阿克拉加斯一帶為止。最終由雙方在迦太基達成協議：前306年（或前307年）簽訂和約，恢復戰前態勢，敘拉古保有哈利克斯河以東的東半部與島內希臘城市的霸權，迦太基保有西半部與北非，雙方都沒有從對方手上取得割地。就戰役層面看，決定性的勝負手是前311年的希梅拉河之戰（迦太基勝）、前310年的白突尼斯之戰（敘拉古勝）與前307年的非洲潰敗（迦太基勝）三次交鋒的累積；就戰爭全體看，第三次西西里戰爭以沒有贏家的和約收場，島上兩種政治勢力各佔一方的格局被固定下來，並在三百餘年後成為羅馬與迦太基爭奪西西里時的既有版圖。
resultEn: Neither side won outright. In 307 BC Agathocles was beaten in North Africa, his army dissolved, and he returned secretly to Sicily, while the son he had left in Africa was killed by his own men; Carthage recovered its losses in Africa, but on the island its western front advanced no further than the neighbourhood of Akragas in the middle of the island. The end came instead through an agreement reached at Carthage: a treaty in 306 or 307 BC restored the situation that had existed before the war, Syracuse kept the eastern half of the island east of the Halycus together with its hegemony over the Greek cities, and Carthage kept the western half and North Africa; neither obtained ceded territory from the other. At the level of battles, the outcome was the accumulated result of three engagements: the Battle of the Himera River in 311 BC, won by Carthage, the Battle of White Tunis in 310 BC, won by Syracuse, and the disaster in Africa in 307 BC, won by Carthage. At the level of the war as a whole, the Third Sicilian War ended in a negotiated peace with no victor, fixed the island into two spheres held one each by the two powers, and so established the territorial arrangement that, more than three centuries later, the Romans and the Carthaginians would each find already in place when they disputed Sicily.
